taste.name: Una familia, dos pesos
taste.trigger: When building hierarchy from an 81px hero down to 14.4px labels
taste.decision: Chose one family (Suisse Intl) in 400/500 with size-only steps over a display/body pairing or bold weights
taste.reason: Because a single voice reads as one studio speaking; contrast comes from scale and space, so the work imagery carries the expression
evidence: 770 nodes in Suisse Intl, no other family

taste.name: Profundidad por inversión, no por sombra
taste.trigger: When separating sections and grouping content
taste.decision: Chose black panels with 72px top corners that slide over white over borders, dividers or card shadows
taste.reason: Because a full-surface inversion is felt as a change of room; hairlines and shadows read as UI chrome
evidence: black covers 76% of measured background area

taste.name: La densidad llega cuando el ojo llega
taste.trigger: When presenting five service lines with paragraph-length descriptions
taste.decision: Chose title-only light bands that expand and darken into art cards at reading position over an always-open card grid
taste.reason: Because the visitor only pays for the detail of the band they are looking at; the rest stays a calm list of names
evidence: collapsed bands #EEEEEE with 37.8px title and number
expanded band: black gradient art, body and Explore

taste.name: El cursor como material
taste.trigger: When giving feedback on hover across nav, buttons and media
taste.decision: Chose a blend-mode cursor, rolling text and ripple-fill buttons with long expo-out easing over color-only hover states
taste.reason: Because motion that answers the hand makes the page feel made by people who build interfaces, which is the product being sold
evidence: nav labels duplicated via data-text for a vertical roll
Contacts: border and ripple layers; transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)
